content:
We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule (target) reproduces the Peterson reaction: formation of alkene from beta-hydroxy silane elimination. The forward reaction: carbon-carbon double bond formed, carbon-silicon bond broken, carbon-oxygen bond broken (beta-hydroxy silane to alkene). So retrosynthetic step: break C=C double bond to give beta-hydroxy silane precursor (i.e., an alkene precursor with SiMe3 attached to carbon and OH on adjacent carbon). So we need to search template catalog for criteria: functional_groups_broken: maybe "trimethylsilyl" and "ketones"? Wait description: "ketones" and "trimethylsilyl" groups are lost. Actually forward reaction: starting from beta-hydroxy silane (has SiMe3 and OH) to alkene + Si-O? Wait Peterson: alpha-silyl carbanion adds to carbonyl to give beta-hydroxy silane, then elimination yields alkene, losing SiMe3 group as siloxane? The functional groups formed: C-C double bond. Broken: carbon-silicon bond, carbon-oxygen bond (the OH). Also ketone is lost? In forward reaction, carbonyl (ketone) is broken? Actually the carbonyl is present in starting material (ketone) which reacts with silyl carbanion to give beta-hydroxy silane; then elimination yields alkene, losing SiMe3 and OH. So forward: ketone (C=O) is broken, trimethylsilyl group is lost. So retrosynthetic: we need to add a carbonyl and a trimethylsilyl group to the alkene? Wait retrosynthesis: target alkene -> precursor beta-hydroxy silane (with SiMe3 and OH). But also could be from ketone + silyl carbanion? The template likely corresponds to Peterson elimination: break C=C to give C(SiMe3) and C(OH). So functional_groups_broken in forward: C-C double bond formed, carbon-silicon bond broken, carbon-oxygen bond broken. So for retrosynthesis, we need template that breaks C=C (i.e., forms C-Si and C-O). So we search template catalog with functional_groups_broken: "C-C double bonds"? Actually broken in forward = formed in retrosynthesis. The search criteria refer to forward reaction. So we need to specify functional_groups_formed: "C-C double bonds" (since forward forms double bond). functional_groups_broken: "ketones", "trimethylsilyl". So we search with functional_groups_formed = ["C-C double bonds"], functional_groups_broken = ["ketones","trimethylsilyl"].

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria.
